entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A Jamuraan chronarch and planeswalker who studied at the Tolarian Academy, phased out Zhalfir, and lost his spark more than once.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An artificer from Shiv and Teferi's friend and love interest who built the Thran Mana Rig and kept his spark in a powerstone.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The planeswalker who founded the Tolarian Academy and was Teferi's mentor in the fight against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem and Teferi's friend who traveled back in time to prevent the Phyrexian attack on Tolaria.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A Tolarian friend of Teferi.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island academy where Teferi studied.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Teferi's homeland, which he phased out to protect it from the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: A reclusive mage and Teferi's friend, manipulated by Kaervek during the Mirage War.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A mage who amassed an army and started a war on the mainland after the phasing of Teferi's Isle.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: A wise man from Corondor imprisoned by Kaervek in an Amber Prison.

entities.name: Queen Yormeba
entities.description: A girl of royal descent Teferi tutored and crowned queen of Zhalfir.

entities.name: Teferi's Isle
entities.description: A hidden realm in the Chaza Isles that phased out of existence for two hundred years.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A goddess who pulled Teferi back into the time stream.

entities.name: Subira
entities.description: A caravan drover who became Teferi's wife and mother of Niambi.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Teferi and Subira's daughter, who lives in Femeref.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who defeated Teferi and led the war on Ravnica.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: An Urborg artificer who allied with Teferi and completed his first planeswalk with his help.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: A Keldon half-elf who allied with Teferi and was used by Jeska as a mana lens.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker coalition Teferi joined to fight Bolas.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who befriended Teferi and bonded to Realmbreaker, sacrificing herself in the invasion.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker who sought the Gatewatch's help to find the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who held the Moonsilver Key and later allied with Teferi's group.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who took the Key and began the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: A key central to restoring balance on Innistrad, later borrowed by Teferi for his Temporal Anchor.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer who built Teferi's time-travel device.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Teferi's time-travel device powered by the Weatherlight's powerstone and the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The weapon activated in the Brothers' War, which Teferi learned is triggered by a person.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders Teferi fought across many planes.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: Great Desparkening
entities.description: The event after the invasion in which planeswalkers lost their sparks.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer whom Teferi's team tried to assassinate.

events.summary: Phyrexians attack Tolaria and Karn travels back in time to stop them, causing the Tolarian Temporal Disaster; Teferi is trapped in a slow-time bubble for thirty years.
events.quote: Teferi survived but was caught in a slow-time bubble for thirty years

events.summary: Jhoira builds a portal machine and Karn and Urza pull Teferi out of the bubble.
events.quote: the resilient bodies of Karn and Urza could pass through and pull Teferi out

events.summary: Teferi's experiment with time magic ignites his spark and he becomes a planeswalker.
events.quote: A Spark ignited . Teferi had become a Planeswalker.

events.summary: Teferi crowns Queen Yormeba and, tired of squabbles, sails with advisors to the Chaza Isles.
events.quote: Teferi crowned her as Queen Yormeba

events.summary: Teferi's attempt to repair the time stream phases everything but bare rock off Teferi's Isle.
events.quote: The Phasing of Teferi's Isle caused everything but the bare rock of the island to instantly phase out of existence.

events.summary: Two hundred years later the isle returns and Teferi learns his cure indirectly caused a great war.
events.quote: After two hundred years, Teferi's Isle returned.

events.summary: Kaervek manipulates Jolrael, imprisons Mangara in an Amber Prison and declares war on the three nations.
events.quote: After imprisoning Mangara in an Amber Prison , they declared war on the three nations.

events.summary: Teferi sinks Kaervek's armada and sends a drake to rescue Jolrael.
events.quote: Teferi finally intervened, sinking Kaervek's armada and sending a drake to rescue Jolrael.

events.summary: As the Phyrexian Invasion begins, Teferi overloads the portals and casts a gigantic phasing spell removing Northwestern Jamuraa (Zhalfir).
events.quote: Teferi weaved it into one gigantic phasing spell that removed Northwestern Jamuraa.

events.summary: Teferi also phases out Shiv to save it from the Phyrexians over Urza's objections.
events.quote: Teferi removed the rest of Shiv from the time stream to save them

events.summary: Teferi returns to Dominaria and gives up his spark to seal the Shiv time rift after losing to Bolas.
events.quote: Teferi gave up his Planeswalker's spark to seal the time rift over Shiv

events.summary: Teferi and Jhoira help Venser complete his first planeswalk.
events.quote: Teferi and Jhoira used their magic to help Venser complete his first planeswalk

events.summary: Teferi weds Subira and they have a daughter, Niambi.
events.quote: They were wed soon after that and had many simple, happy years together.

events.summary: Jhoira returns Teferi's spark to him in a powerstone and he joins the Gatewatch against Bolas.
events.quote: After he became a Planeswalker again he joined the Gatewatch to fight Nicol Bolas .

events.summary: Teferi slows time around the Planar Bridge and saves many lives during the War of the Spark.
events.quote: Teferi slowed down the time around the Planar Bridge

events.summary: Teferi's team nearly assassinates Liliana but Bolas saves her; Teferi slows their falls.
events.quote: Teferi saved himself and the other three Planeswalkers by slowing their falls.

events.summary: Teferi meets Wrenn on Innistrad and they are trapped in a time loop he later undoes.
events.quote: trapping him and Wrenn in a loop of time

events.summary: Teferi's group retrieves the Moonsilver Key from Markov Manor with Sigarda's help but Olivia Voldaren steals it and the Eternal Night begins.
events.quote: Thus, the Eternal Night began.

events.summary: Teferi and allies crash Olivia's wedding; the Key is recovered and balance is restored.
events.quote: After the balance between night and day was restored, Katilda allowed Teferi to borrow the key

events.summary: Teferi is gravely injured in the Phyrexian attack on New Argive and later serves as the New Coalition's general.
events.quote: he served as the New Coalition's general and quartermaster

events.summary: Teferi travels back in time with Saheeli's device to find how to fire the Golgothian Sylex.
events.quote: Teferi enlisted Saheeli to develop a device in Urza's Tower

events.summary: Teferi learns the Sylex is triggered by a person and is lost in the time stream when the Anchor is damaged.
events.quote: it was not a spell or artifact but a person who activated it

events.summary: Teferi finds himself in Zhalfir, now a pocket plane, and recommits to fighting the Phyrexians.
events.quote: he had arrived in Zhalfir

events.summary: Teferi leads the Zhalfirin charge against Phyrexia, resulting in the deaths of Vorinclex, Jin-Gitaxias and Elesh Norn.
events.quote: Teferi led the Zhalfirin charge against Phyrexia

events.summary: Teferi's spark fades in the Great Desparkening.
events.quote: Teferi's spark faded due to the Great Desparkening

relations.quote: like his mentor Urza before him

relations.note: Romantic feelings developed; she declined his proposal.
relations.quote: some romantic feelings developed between Teferi and Jhoira
They were wed soon after that
Teferi was the one who raised their daughter.
he joined the Gatewatch to fight Nicol Bolas

relations.note: Old friend who later defected from Kaervek.
Imprisoned him in an Amber Prison.
relations.quote: After imprisoning Mangara in an Amber Prison

relations.note: She promised to help undo the Zhalfir spell and fought beside him.
relations.quote: Wrenn promised to return and help the Planeswalker undo the spell

relations.note: Lost a battle to Bolas and fought in the War of the Spark.
relations.quote: After losing a battle against Nicol Bolas
He is considered the Father of Zhalfir
